# Pinned coding fixtures

This directory contains three fixed Python source fixtures and their two
matching tests. Their SHA-256 digests are recorded in `labrepair/q4_pins.py`.
The loader parses a narrow set of literal constants; it never imports, runs, or
stages these fixture files. They are not evidence of sandbox isolation or a
live Nebius execution.

This is a selected source snapshot without its original archive, operations
logs, account identifiers, or Git history. Confirm redistribution terms before
making the repository public.
